shop_rules: Every voucher costs $10 (reduced by Clearance Sale/Liquidation, rounded as in shop.json).

The shop has 1 voucher slot. A voucher is rolled when an ante starts and stays for every shop of that ante; once bought it is NOT replaced until the next ante (after the Boss Blind is beaten). Rerolls never change it.
Each Voucher Tag adds 1 extra voucher to the next shop only (no duplicates within a shop).

Pick = uniform random among vouchers that are unlocked, not yet redeemed this run, not already shown in this shop, and whose 'requires' voucher has been redeemed this run. If none remain, Blank is offered.
Each voucher can be redeemed only once per run. Upgrades require the base voucher redeemed earlier in the same run.
Effects are permanent for the rest of the run. Starting decks may pre-redeem vouchers (Magic, Nebula, Zodiac).

vouchers.name: Overstock
vouchers.effect: +1 card slot in the shop (2 -> 3). Empty slots restock immediately.
vouchers.description: +1 card slot available in shop

vouchers.name: Overstock Plus
vouchers.effect: +1 more shop card slot (3 -> 4).
vouchers.description: +1 card slot available in shop

vouchers.name: Clearance Sale
vouchers.effect: Everything in the shop (cards, packs and vouchers, not rerolls) costs 25% less. Also lowers sell values because sell = half the (discounted) buy cost.
vouchers.description: All cards and packs in shop are 25% off

vouchers.name: Liquidation
vouchers.effect: Shop discount becomes 50%.
vouchers.description: All cards and packs in shop are 50% off

vouchers.name: Hone
vouchers.effect: Foil, Holographic and Polychrome appear 2x as often (edition rate 2). Negative unchanged. Affects shop/pack jokers and Standard-pack cards, not Illusion shop cards.
vouchers.description: Foil, Holographic, and Polychrome cards appear 2X more often

vouchers.name: Glow Up
vouchers.effect: Foil, Holographic and Polychrome appear 4x as often (edition rate 4).
vouchers.description: Foil, Holographic, and Polychrome cards appear 4X more often

vouchers.name: Reroll Surplus
vouchers.effect: Shop rerolls cost $2 less (base $5 -> $3).
vouchers.description: Rerolls cost $2 less

vouchers.name: Reroll Glut
vouchers.effect: Rerolls cost a further $2 less (base $3 -> $1).
vouchers.description: Rerolls cost an additional $2 less

vouchers.name: Crystal Ball
vouchers.effect: +1 consumable slot.
vouchers.description: +1 consumable slot

vouchers.name: Omen Globe
vouchers.effect: Each card in an Arcana pack has a 20% chance to be a Spectral card instead of a Tarot.
vouchers.description: Spectral cards may appear in any of the Arcana Packs

vouchers.name: Telescope
vouchers.effect: Celestial packs always include the Planet for your most played poker hand (ties -> the higher-tier hand), even if you already hold it.
vouchers.description: Celestial Packs always contain the Planet card for your most played poker hand

vouchers.name: Observatory
vouchers.effect: Each Planet card in your consumable area gives x1.5 Mult when its poker hand is played (after jokers).
vouchers.description: Planet cards in your consumable area give X1.5 Mult for their specified poker hand

vouchers.name: Grabber
vouchers.effect: Permanently +1 hand per round.
vouchers.description: Permanently gain +1 hand per round

vouchers.name: Nacho Tong
vouchers.effect: Permanently +1 more hand per round.
vouchers.description: Permanently gain an additional +1 hand per round

vouchers.name: Wasteful
vouchers.effect: Permanently +1 discard per round.
vouchers.description: Permanently gain +1 discard each round

vouchers.name: Recyclomancy
vouchers.effect: Permanently +1 more discard per round.
vouchers.description: Permanently gain an additional +1 discard each round

vouchers.name: Tarot Merchant
vouchers.effect: Tarot shop weight 4 -> 9.6 (about 2x as frequent).
vouchers.description: Tarot cards appear 2X more frequently in the shop

vouchers.name: Tarot Tycoon
vouchers.effect: Tarot shop weight -> 32 (about 4x).
vouchers.description: Tarot cards appear 4X more frequently in the shop

vouchers.name: Planet Merchant
vouchers.effect: Planet shop weight 4 -> 9.6 (about 2x).
vouchers.description: Planet cards appear 2X more frequently in the shop

vouchers.name: Planet Tycoon
vouchers.effect: Planet shop weight -> 32 (about 4x).
vouchers.description: Planet cards appear 4X more frequently in the shop

vouchers.name: Seed Money
vouchers.effect: Interest cap raised to $10 per round (earned up to $50 held).
vouchers.description: Raise the cap on interest earned in each round to $10

vouchers.name: Money Tree
vouchers.effect: Interest cap raised to $20 per round (earned up to $100 held).
vouchers.description: Raise the cap on interest earned in each round to $20

vouchers.name: Blank
vouchers.effect: No effect (only unlocks/enables Antimatter; also the fallback when no other voucher is available).
vouchers.description: Does nothing?

vouchers.name: Antimatter
vouchers.effect: +1 joker slot.
vouchers.description: +1 Joker Slot

vouchers.name: Magic Trick
vouchers.effect: Plain playing cards can appear in the shop (playing-card weight 0 -> 4), $1 each.
vouchers.description: Playing cards can be purchased from the shop

vouchers.name: Illusion
vouchers.effect: Shop playing cards may be Enhanced (40%) and/or have an edition (20%: Poly 15% / Holo 35% / Foil 50%). Text also promises seals, but none appear (bug in 1.0.1o).
vouchers.description: Playing cards in shop may have an Enhancement, Edition, and/or a Seal

vouchers.name: Hieroglyph
vouchers.effect: Immediately -1 Ante; permanently -1 hand per round.
vouchers.description: -1 Ante, -1 hand each round

vouchers.name: Petroglyph
vouchers.effect: Immediately -1 Ante; permanently -1 discard per round.
vouchers.description: -1 Ante, -1 discard each round

vouchers.name: Director's Cut
vouchers.effect: Reroll the Boss Blind once per ante for $10.
vouchers.description: Reroll Boss Blind 1 time per Ante, $10 per roll

vouchers.name: Retcon
vouchers.effect: Reroll the Boss Blind any number of times, $10 each.
vouchers.description: Reroll Boss Blind unlimited times, $10 per roll

vouchers.name: Paint Brush
vouchers.effect: +1 hand size.
vouchers.description: +1 hand size

vouchers.name: Palette
vouchers.effect: +1 more hand size.
vouchers.description: +1 hand size
